svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.rock-cycle-class-process-model", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Selected five-state rock-cycle relation in ten independent route panels, two columns of five. State key:circle=magma,triangle=igneous,hexagon=loose sediments,square=clastic sedimentary,diamond=metamorphic. Keys are taught symbolic markers,not natural rock shapes/textures or mineral identification. Each row reads source to target via rightward equilateral open arrowhead detached from shaft. Rows are alternatives,not compulsory sequence or row-major cycle. Ten routes exactly match pinned142 model;chemical/biological sedimentary routes and tectonic budgets not exhaustive. Metamorphism is solid state;melting leads to melt. Mandatory external state AND per-row process key,recognition/touch pending.", "geometry_exception": "Index native1.2mm line-sampling dots with3.1mm centre guard;shared junctions de-duplicated. Selected rock-cycle relation with mandatory external state/process key;ten independent alternative route panels,not compulsory sequence. No material or recognition code inherent in an outline.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}
